question:
Which validation path should run before the release? Review the complete deployment plan, including rollback and recovery, before making a selection.
Keep the production session running while checks execute in isolation.
Verify the local changes first, then the package and the remote reader.
If a step fails, collect its receipt and leave the current deployment intact.
Only publish after every required check passes.
The final checkpoint is the operator-owned rollout.

choices.label: Run isolated source validation and review every failing check before proceeding
choices.summary: Execute the focused test suite against disposable configuration and state. Preserve the complete failure output and verify cleanup before returning to the existing session.

choices.label: Validate the packaged application across all supported environments
choices.summary:
Build the pinned package and run its real command interface.
Compare the installed runtime version against the declared release.
Check a narrow window and a short window.
Verify Unicode titles and full descriptions.
Exercise scrolling without changing the selection.
Confirm that the final line is reachable.
Do not replace the operator configuration.

choices.label: Keep the current deployment
choices.summary: Leave production untouched and return to the pending work.
